currentObjective: Implement deterministic intraprocedural Roslyn complexity extraction
decisions: Phase 3 extraction is intraprocedural and returns only Phase 2 ComplexityExpression values.
MethodAnalysisContext is method-local and stores SemanticModel, IMethodSymbol, CancellationToken, and immutable input-size variables resolved by InputSizeResolver.
Basic method and block extraction is implemented through MethodComplexityExtractor plus BasicOperationAnalyzer.
Sequential statements are composed with ComplexityComposer.Sequential; no separate Big-O algebra is implemented in the Roslyn layer.

Only explicitly safe basic operations are classified as O(1): literals, primitive arithmetic/comparison, simple local declarations, simple assignments, increment/decrement, return, array Length, string Length, and array element access.
Custom properties, custom indexers, object/array creation, unsupported invocations, unsupported loops, and branching remain Unknown or out of scope for this step.
Linear foreach loops, safe linear for loops, safe logarithmic for loops, and proven while/do-while loops are composed with ComplexityComposer.Nested.
Logarithmic loop extraction recognizes only constant multiplicative or divisive factors greater than one and normalizes all constant bases to O(log n).
While and do-while extraction uses simple method-local loop-bound facts from prior local declarations or simple assignments, plus one direct compatible control-variable mutation in the loop body.

LoopBoundAnalyzer returns Unknown for unproven loop origins, missing conditions, wrong increment variables, inconsistent progressions, invocation bounds, invalid multiplicative factors, nonconstant factors, unrelated conditions, and conflicting control-variable mutations.
BCL/LINQ mappings, call graph analysis, recursion handling, product diagnostics, and Complexity Model changes remain out of scope for Phase 3.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.

Do not implement BCL mappings, LINQ mappings, call graph analysis, recursion handling, BIG000x, BIG100x, CodeFixProvider, Workspaces, solver, calibration, amortized, parallel, probabilistic, or memory complexity in Phase 3.
Keep BIG9000 unchanged and disabled by default.
Respect CancellationToken and avoid I/O, network access, process execution, and global mutable analyzer state.
validations: Release build passed after Step 5 implementation.
Release tests passed after Step 5 implementation.
knownPendingItems: Advanced CFG/data-flow remains out of scope; while/do-while recognition is limited to simple local initialization and a single direct provable control-variable mutation.
